The '''Imperial crawler tank''', also known as the '''Sith siege tank''', was a model of treaded military ground transport used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] throughout the [[Great Galactic War]] and into the [[Galactic War]]. They were used both as troop transports and mobile artillery platforms.

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
During the game they can be found at planets that have both a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] presence. They are found on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], [[Quesh]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] (damaged, as well as working), [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] (damaged, as well as working), and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They are the Imperial version of the [[Manka-class armored transport]].
